name: Arcade Dusk 32
note: The single source of truth for every colour in the game. Sprites, backgrounds, UI and font must use ONLY these colours (plus fully-transparent pixels, alpha 0). Tools read this file; the game imports it. Change it here and everything follows.
transparencyRule: Alpha is binary. A pixel is either fully opaque (255) or fully transparent (0). No partial alpha - it produces halos when scaled and breaks the pixel-art read.
